Consulting in Open Source technologies and Cloud Computing.


Consulting

We provide consulting services for your architecture and infrastructure, helping your company improve its technology environment and prepare for future growth. Our main goal is to work with complete transparency throughout every analysis while maintaining efficiency during project implementation. We work with project management and tracking tools, maintain close communication with the client throughout the process, and provide ongoing support.

Information Security

We are prepared to work with security assessments and vulnerability analysis of your environment, providing penetration testing services, Web and Desktop Application Security, and detailed security analysis covering databases and e-commerce platforms. Our team works remotely and flexibly, allowing us to adapt to the scale and needs of your company. We also work with trusted national and international partners to help improve your company's security.

Web Development

Every day, more high-quality Open Source technologies become available, including e-commerce platforms, operating systems, software, and applications for management and security. Many of these technologies are already widely used by major companies such as Amazon, Netflix, and Google. We specialize in Open Source technologies and provide development, support, and consulting services to help your company grow quickly, securely, and at scale.
